card.name: Right before a named interacting drug
card.fires_on: Words just before a co-used drug or drug class is named, such as 'with' or 'of' after concomitant use, and the start of a drug name inside a list. Seen in interaction and warning sections.

modes.label: Linking word before interacting drugs
modes.description: A small word like 'with' or 'of' after 'concomitant use' or 'coadministration', where a drug class is expected next.

card.plain: It lights up when the text is about to name another drug taken alongside the main one.
